widgets_values:
使い方｜毎回変更するのは2か所だけ。①左の三面図を1枚選ぶ。②「02」の大きなテキスト欄へAIが返したJSON全文を貼る。JSON作成にはprompt_guide_ja.md / prompt_guide_en.md / prompt_guide_zh-CN.mdをAIチャットに添付し、同じ三面図と作りたい動画を送る。
JSONには k0_prompt / k1_end / scene1_h3 / k2_end / scene2_h3 / k3_end / scene3_h3 の7項目が必要。現在の入力例は汎用の温室と紙飛行機。自分の三面図と作りたい動画に合うJSONへ替える。
「固定・変更不要」の折りたたみノードにある三面図の説明、K0維持の指示、FL2VAの時刻指定は通常触らない。K1〜K3は各々K0と三面図を参照する。H3はK0→K1、K1→K2、K2→K3を各約3秒で生成・結合する。
JSONを壊すと抽出結果が空になるため、AIのJSONを最初の{から最後の}まで丸ごと貼る。完成動画はComfyUIのoutput/qwen_h3_3scene/final_*.mp4。

widgets_values:
{
  "k0_prompt": "Use the supplied single three-view character sheet (front, side and back) only as identity reference for ONE adult character. Do not draw a turnaround sheet, panels, labels, or multiple people. Make one finished image in the visual style of the reference sheet. The character stands in a sunlit greenhouse wearing a plain blue jacket, white shirt, charcoal trousers, and brown shoes, holding one white paper airplane at waist height. Eye-level fixed camera, full-body portrait. A small wooden table stands to the right, with potted plants and window frames behind. Soft daylight. Keep the window and table layout stable. No extra airplane, person, text, or invented accessories. K0 is the master for clothing, fixed background layout, lighting, framing, and character scale.",
  "k1_end": "In the same greenhouse, clothing, daylight, camera view, and scale, the character raises the single white paper airplane in the right hand to shoulder height, ready to throw it toward the table on the right. The left arm is relaxed; the gaze follows the intended flight path. Keep the existing table, plants, and windows. No duplicate objects or people.",
  "scene1_h3": "[Shot 1] In one continuous fixed-camera shot, the character lifts the single white paper airplane from waist height to shoulder height and looks toward the table on the right. Leaves on the potted plants sway gently throughout the full three seconds. Window frames, table, outfit, lighting, and camera position stay stable. End with the airplane held at shoulder height as in Picture 2.\noverall_soundscape: Soft greenhouse ambience, leaves rustling, and light paper movement.\nnon_diegetic_music: N/A",
  "k2_end": "In the same greenhouse, clothing, daylight, camera view, and scale, the character has just thrown the single white paper airplane. The right arm extends toward the table on the right; the airplane is visibly in midair between the character and the table. The eyes follow it. Keep the existing table, plants, and windows. No duplicate objects or people.",
  "scene2_h3": "[Shot 1] Starting with the airplane raised, the character extends the right arm and releases the single white paper airplane toward the table on the right. The airplane glides visibly through the air and the eyes track it. Leaves on the potted plants continue swaying gently throughout the full three seconds. Window frames, table, outfit, lighting, framing, and camera position stay stable. End with the airplane in midair and the arm extended as in Picture 2.\noverall_soundscape: Soft leaves rustling and a light swish of paper.\nnon_diegetic_music: N/A",
  "k3_end": "In the same greenhouse, clothing, daylight, camera view, and scale, the single white paper airplane rests on the existing wooden table to the right. The character lowers the right arm, looks at the airplane, and smiles. Keep the plants and windows in their original positions. No duplicate objects or people.",
  "scene3_h3": "[Shot 1] The single white paper airplane glides from its midair position, descends, and comes to rest on the existing wooden table to the right. The character follows it with the eyes, lowers the right arm, and smiles. Leaves on the potted plants continue swaying gently throughout the full three seconds. Window frames, table, outfit, lighting, framing, and camera position stay stable. End with the airplane on the table as in Picture 2.\noverall_soundscape: Soft leaves rustling, faint paper glide, and a gentle tap on the table.\nnon_diegetic_music: N/A"
}
